call_sites: imas_ambix/agent/gpu_watch/__init__.py:12 re-exports view.main as the console entry
imas_ambix/agent/gpu_watch/view.py:570 sample_readings constructs launcher.RemoteSampler when remote is None
imas_ambix/agent/gpu_watch/launcher.py:262 step_argv launches -m imas_ambix.agent.gpu_watch.sampler inside the server's job

findings.text: The live loop keys the pool by two different strings: ensure and drain use the group's first declaration (view.py:660-662), while the per-declaration state lookup uses that declaration's own host (view.py:672). When the endpoint document names one machine twice (98dci4-gpu-0003 and 98dci4-gpu-0003.iter.org, which _machine groups into one step), the second spelling calls state() with a key the pool never keys on, gets (None, None) and is rendered by _no_job_reading as 'no job to sample' — a false claim, since a job is running and a step was opened for it. The node's own live-ui.log shows it in the first frames ('not sampled: waiting for the step's first sample' for the bare name beside 'no job to sample' / 'jobs none resident' for the .iter.org name), which contradicts the evidence fragment's statement that both declarations 'render the same figures'; the sample_readings path (view.py:590-601) groups correctly and does not share the defect, so the same rule is implemented two ways.

_open_step gives every step stderr=subprocess.PIPE (launcher.py:212), but the live sampler's reader thread consumes only proc.stdout and never drains stderr; a step that writes more than one pipe buffer (~64 KiB, e.g. repeated srun warnings) blocks on write, stops streaming, and the pool then holds a live-looking step that will never produce a sample and never reports a reason. The one-shot path is unaffected because communicate() reads both pipes.

The only log carrying the base revision (dedeb919) reports '62 passed', and 62 is the head tree's collection count (57 at base, measured with --collect-only in scratch extractions of both revisions), so it is not a pre-change arm and cannot evidence absence of a regression. The reviewed manifest records no baseline_suite or after_suite at all, so added_failure_count here is derived from the after arm alone (gate.log, zero failing ids).

EXIT=0, tests/test_gpu_watch.py covers all four launcher assertions, and the fragment plus live-steps-before/during/after.txt and live-ui.log carry the real run — though the fragment's claim that both declarations render the same figures is contradicted by live-ui.log's first frames.

justifications.durability: tests/test_gpu_watch.py:451 reddens under the recorded negative control when the empty-step reason is dropped, and the argv, restart and terminate assertions are independent of the code they check, but --live — half the goal and the locus of the view.py:672 defect — has no test at all.
justifications.evidence: gate.log records '62 passed in 0.90s' with EXIT=0 at the reviewed head and ruff.log records EXIT=0, and the real fleet-node run is recorded with before/during/after step snapshots, but no readable base arm exists (gate1.log's dedeb919 header carries a 62-test count only the head tree collects) and the manifest records no baseline_suite or after_suite.
justifications.fit: The additions follow the package's dataclass-with-docstring and function-local-import idiom (view.py:513 _machine beside the existing view.py:506 _is_local, view.py:694 _endpoint_document for the local import) and introduce no plan, version or ticket label in any path, symbol, docstring or commit message.
justifications.goal_fidelity: launcher.py:120 step_argv opens the step inside the server's own job and view.py:570/632 sample it one-shot and live, which is the goal; view.py:672 mislabels a duplicate declaration of a running server as 'no job to sample'.
justifications.reuse: Every added definition extends an existing owner: launcher.py:112 and launcher.py:344 use node_probe.run_capture/RunFn and node_probe.scheduler_node_name, and sampler.py:45 frames node_probe.NodeProbe.stream rather than copying the probe; a search of imas_ambix and tests for srun, --overlap, --jobid and for another Popen/JSON-line streamer found no prior owner of a remote step launcher (imas_ambix/bench/tokenizer.py is the only other Popen user and streams no node samples).
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in the diff — imas_ambix/agent/gpu_watch/{launcher,sampler,view}.py, tests/test_gpu_watch.py and the evidence fragment — lies inside the fence declared at the source prompt's orientation_write_paths.
